title: Lawful War
description: Adds a press helmet and chestplate!
body:
This teeny tiny mod adds a **press vest** and **press helmet**. This mod is mainly meant for roleplay, but also includes crafting recipes using string and iron as well as, _at least in my opinion_, balanced stats for survival gameplay.

![A minecraft character wearing a press vest and helmet in front of a stone brick wall.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35547894a553b8ffa1ba6abbcfae17f0228d0d1b.png)

Created in McCreator.
